_comment: Pre-registration for the event-regime conditioning hypothesis (EVENT_REGIME_PLAN.md). Written and committed BEFORE any analysis run. Path note: the plan specified outputs/event_prereg.json, which is gitignored -- committing there is a silent no-op and a pre-registration absent from history has no evidential value. Relocated to tracked prereg/. See EVENT_REGIME_REVIEW.md section A3.
hypothesis: The ORB continuation edge degrades when a session's price path is governed by gradually revealed macro narrative (pressers, Q&A, testimony) rather than by order-flow continuation from the opening range.
predicted_mechanism: higher post-breakout reversal rate (tap_in_bar_idx not None)
primary_test: day-label permutation, pooled across rankable families, T1+T2, one permutation of the union date axis per draw applied to every family/channel/rr level
originating_families: UNRESOLVED -- user input required. Must be filled with the two paper-traded models' family keys (instrument, session, range_minutes, entry_mode, closure_tf, direction) before the pooled headline is computed. Those two are excluded from the pooled headline and reported separately as Level 0 (plan sections 1.3 and 6.2).
holdout_contamination_note: Plan section 1.2 requires this be resolved BEFORE writing code. It is not resolved. A paper account running forward through 2026 very likely overlaps the 2026-02-01 holdout, in which case the holdout is contaminated FOR THIS HYPOTHESIS and section 6.5's test is not independent confirmation. Until resolved, all work on this branch is to be read as IN-SAMPLE, per plan section 1.2 option (b). No out-of-sample claim may be made from this branch without first setting these fields.

corrections_to_plan_applied_here.pooling_permutation: Plan section 6.2 Level 1 says shuffle day labels within each family independently. That destroys cross-family correlation (all ~1190 families draw from ~24 instrument-sessions and share calendar days and price paths), producing a null that is far too tight and p-values far too small -- the section 6.1 clustering error committed one level up. Corrected to: one permutation of the union date axis per draw, applied to every family, channel and rr level. Consistent with the plan's own (correct) joint-draw rule for the maxT grid.
corrections_to_plan_applied_here.mde_formula: Plan section 7's MDE uses per-trade counts, treating correlated trades as independent draws. Effective n is distinct contaminated DAYS, not trades; the closed form overstates power by roughly 3-5x. Replaced with MDE = 2.486 * sd(delta_permuted) taken directly from the permutation draws, which encodes the design's correlation structure by construction.
corrections_to_plan_applied_here.prereg_path: outputs/ is gitignored; relocated to tracked prereg/.
corrections_to_plan_applied_here.stratification: Permutation blocks on weekday in addition to volatility tercile. FOMC decisions are Wednesday in essentially every case; free permutation assigns labels to weekdays that cannot occur under the real calendar.
corrections_to_plan_applied_here.unit_of_analysis: Day-level: (instrument, session, date) -> mean net_r pooled across families. Enforces the joint-draw discipline through the data layout so it cannot be violated by accident.

gate_run_on_this_branch.name: FOMC anticipation gate
gate_run_on_this_branch.status: PRE-REGISTERED, NOT YET RUN AT TIME OF WRITING
gate_run_on_this_branch.what_it_is: A feasibility gate on the cheapest decisive slice: FOMC decision dates only, POST_EXIT_SAME_DAY (anticipation) channel only, day-level, in-sample. Purpose is to decide whether the ~300-row Phase A calendar build is worth a day of manual sourcing.
gate_run_on_this_branch.what_it_is_not: It is NOT the test of the hypothesis and its p-value is NOT a finding. ~40 usable event days per instrument-session, one channel, in-sample, with no multiplicity correction across the channel x tier grid. The plan's section 6.2 Level-1 pooled test is what decides the hypothesis. This distinction is recorded BEFORE the run specifically so that a favourable gate result cannot later be promoted to a headline.
gate_run_on_this_branch.why_this_channel: Plan section 1.4 identifies it as dominant for NY and LDN: FOMC statement 14:00 ET and presser 14:30 ET fall entirely OUTSIDE the 09:30-12:00 ET window, so the operative mechanism is anticipation, not shock. Every FOMC decision in the sample carries a presser (Powell moved to all-meeting pressers in January 2019), making this the purest DIFFUSE anticipation case available.
gate_run_on_this_branch.predicted_direction: mean day-level net_r on FOMC decision dates < mean on clean dates (one-sided)
gate_run_on_this_branch.primary_statistic: day-count-weighted mean across instrument-sessions of (mean day net_r | FOMC) - (mean day net_r | clean)
gate_run_on_this_branch.null: permutation of FOMC labels over the union date axis, count held fixed, 20000 draws, one permutation per draw applied to all instrument-sessions
variants_prespecified: stratified by weekday x parkinson_vol_14d tercile
placebo: all event dates shifted +7 calendar days
placebo: all event dates shifted -7 calendar days

sensitivity: excluding 2020-03-03 (unscheduled emergency cut, statement ~10:00 ET, INSIDE the NY window -- the only genuine in-path FOMC event in the sample, sitting in the most extreme month in the sample)
mechanism_metrics_available_without_new_: tp_hit_rate by rr level (degradation should steepen with rr)
mechanism_metrics_deferred: vol-profile shape (requires 1m bar re-walk; plan section 6.3 requires this BEFORE interpreting any P&L result, so it is a Phase A/B prerequisite for the full test, not for this gate)
gate_run_on_this_branch.decision_rule: This gate does not accept or reject the hypothesis. If the effect is absent AND the day-level MDE shows the gate had power to see the pre-registered 0.05 R, the ~250 additional calendar rows are unlikely to change that and Phase A should not be funded on this channel's account. If the effect is present, or if the MDE shows the gate was underpowered to see 0.05 R, Phase A proceeds -- an underpowered null is uninformative, not evidence of absence.
gate_run_on_this_branch.eligibility: src.filters.trade_eligibility, families with >= MIN_TRADES_FOR_RANKING (100) eligible trades, dates strictly before holdout_start

calendar_provenance.sourcing_note: Meeting dates fetched from Federal Reserve archives, not recalled from memory, per plan section 3.2. Intraday release convention (statement 14:00 ET, presser 14:30 ET) is the documented post-2013 standard and is flagged verified=True for scheduled meetings; the 2020 unscheduled meetings carry verified=False because their intraday timing was not confirmed against a primary source.
calendar_provenance.excluded_deliberately: Notation votes and Statement on Longer-Run Goals releases (2020-08-27, 2025-08-22) are not rate decisions. 2019-10-04/11 was a repo-operations statement, not a rate decision. 2020-03-15 fell on a Sunday -- no session, drops out naturally. 2020-03-17/18 was cancelled.
